34f86d2055.q: What average water savings percentage does CMP Efficiency Solutions' valve deliver across all commercial verticals?
34f86d2055.a: Our company average is 21% across all verticals. The efficacy of the valve is really determined by the pressure that's coming through the municipal water meter and therefore it's also driven by how close the valve is to that meter. The higher the pressure, the more effective the valve will work and the higher results that you'll get.

4ca34cb01f.q: How does CMP Efficiency Solutions analyze water consumption savings differently across hospitality, food manufacturing, and other verticals?
4ca34cb01f.a: Every vertical has its own metric by what you measure the success of the product at. For a car wash, it's how much water are you spending per car. At a hotel, it's how much water are you spending on water per door night. When we're doing our analysis, we're really looking at 12 months worth of bills and want to know an exact comparison to before the valve and after the valve.

c2927c2b2d.q: What valve sizes does CMP Efficiency Solutions offer for commercial applications like hotels, car washes, and breweries?
c2927c2b2d.a: Standard valve sizes start at a half an inch, three quarters of an inch, mostly for residential. On the commercial side, you'll start seeing some at one inch. The most common size is a two inch, which would cover most car washes, hotels, senior living, multifamily. For food and beverage manufacturing and golf courses and irrigation, the size of the valves go up—we've seen orders with 8-inch, 10-inch, and 12-inch valves.
